notes: בְּלוֹא → *before* fused and headed on the negative, as מֵאֵין → *without* is (rules 23, 30, 48); the margin's literal gloss *without enchantment* corroborates without deciding (rule 38).

בַעַל … לָּשׁוֹן → *charmer* retained as one unit with the article separately aligned to the written *the*: this is exactly rule 30's דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים → *chronicles* shape, where the two lexical nouns share the single English word and the segmented article takes its own.
The whole-verse alternative marginal rendering was read and set aside (rule 38).
